name: Chaney
description: An old druid who teaches Greensleeves magic and dies donating her life force to her.

description_citations.text: "Shattered Chains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves is compelled to leave camp and finds Chaney, who trains her; years pass in Chaney's house.
timeline.quote: time in Chaney's house flows differently

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney discover the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, made by the Sages of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: the fallen star Mana Vault is, in reality, the " Stone Brain "

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lily and Greensleeves shift away with Chaney's artifacts.
timeline.quote: Both are now able to successfully teleport away.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chaney dies of old age, donating her life force to Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: while Chaney dies of old age, donating her life force to Greensleeves.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three years on, Greensleeves is weary and visited by Chaney's shade, who warns of a final sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves is also frequently visited by the shade of Chaney , who advises the druid, in cryptic words, that she'll need to make the "final sacrifice".

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain and learns its ultimate secret lies in the College of Lat-Nam; Chaney's shade passes into the afterlife.
timeline.quote: The same night, Chaney's shade passes in the afterlife, after reminding Greensleeves once more of the final sacrifice.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Led by a strange voice, Greensleeves finds the druid Chaney, who trains her; five years pass in a few days and she returns grown and more skilled.
timeline.quote: Despite training for around five years, only a few days passed.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Archdruid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney learn the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, and Greensleeves uses it on Haakon.
timeline.quote: the Mana Vault was in reality the Stone Brain

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chaney, dying of old age, gives Greensleeves her remaining life force, making her an archdruid.
timeline.quote: Chaney gave her remaining life force to Greensleeves, making her an archdruid.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The army liberates almost all of Northern Aerona from evil wizards, but Greensleeves is worn down and Chaney's shade warns of a final sacrifice.
timeline.quote: liberated almost all of Northern Aerona from evil wizards

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves learns the Stone Brain's ultimate secret lies in the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam, and the army teleports there; Chaney's shade passes on.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves meets Chaney in northern Aerona and is taught to harness mana and about planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Chaney taught Greensleeves how to harness mana

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves trains for about five years while only days pass outside, emerging years older and a more skilled wizard and druid.
timeline.quote: Despite training for around five years, only a few days passed.

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chaney dies of mortality in 4074 AR and her life force is absorbed by Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: In her dying moment, her life force was absorbed by Greensleeves.

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chaney returns as a shade urging Greensleeves to make the final sacrifice, then passes on after Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: Three years later, Chaney returned as a shade

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
